items.title: Wendell Harrison interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, November 10, 2022 [interview 1 of 2]
items.q: I don’t know if you know Charles McPherson? ... Charles McPherson was sounding exactly like Bird under the tutelage of Barry Harris you know.

ctx.x: I was fortunate. As a kid. Well I had a different experience probably. I played piano at five years old. My parents started me playing the piano because I was a nervous kid running around. And they would take me shopping and I was so crazy I would just pull the groceries off the shelves and put them on the floor. You know I was hard to contain you know. And concentration was like a gnat, I couldn’t concentrate on anything. So when people say well give him a piano, take him — he needs discipline. He needs to be…

got a clarinet. I’m playing it to this day, the clarinet. So I started playing that in elementary school. But the thing is, because I had to sit still and decipher notes on the page, that was a job for me. It was a job you know. I didn’t like it. But I concentrated and when I concentrated I got rewards. And then when I got in middle school we got — we had these different performances, we called them like assemblies where like we would play for plays and you’d play for dance shows and so I got attention because at…
